l1_words.meaning: to attend, to be present at

pattern_explanation: Spanish and English both inherited many words from Latin, so their spellings often look alike, yet over time some of these words drifted apart in meaning. Learners who match words by sight alone are likely to pick the English look-alike instead of the true meaning.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word written as actualmente looks like the English word 'actually', but it means 'currently', so a learner who relies on appearance will choose the wrong meaning.
